name: ai-use-disclosure
description: Drafts an honest, right-sized statement of how AI was actually used in a piece of work, matched to where it's going — a journal, a classroom, a workplace. It reconstructs how AI actually contributed during the session (ideation, drafting, editing, verification) and writes a disclosure sized to the venue's norms, from a one-line note to a formal statement. It's a finishing pass: spell-check at the end, not autocorrect while you type. Use when a piece is ready to ship and needs an AI-use statement, acknowledgment, or disclosure. Trigger phrases include "write an AI disclosure", "how do I disclose AI use", "AI use statement", "acknowledge AI in this", "disclosure for this paper".
